errors.what: Three of my own test expectations were wrong on first run (max-deflection formula for the wrong side of the load, shear sign at a cantilever tip, kN vs N in the metric case); the engine was right in each, confirmed by hand.
Round-off of ~1e-13 from spans with no effect on a determinate overhang leaked into the 'live on spans' pattern list; fixed with a 1e-10 relative threshold and a test.
Page overflowed sideways at 390 px (grid column 1fr instead of minmax(0,1fr)) and the hidden custom-section fields showed (display:grid beat [hidden]); both caught in Chromium screenshots and fixed.
First push blocked by the post front-matter hook: description 202 chars > 160; shortened.

First CI run red on three real checks: check_table_headers (result tables were empty in the markup, filled by script), siblings orphan budget (the new venture had no inbound sibling link; added from the deck lumber page and shed designer), and the same siblings test inside portfolio-pages. A first try put the deck link inside an FAQ answer, which broke wall-framing-takeoff's FAQ-matches-JSON-LD test; moved to its own paragraph.

run_workflow_locally --for-changes ran past the 10 min background limit (portfolio-pages' site-builder tests alone hit the 300 s step timeout); verified those suites directly instead (platform/pages 1560/1560; venture tests for the three touched ventures). shed-designer's browser test failed once under parallel load and passed alone, both with and without this change.

doc_friction.issue: Says 'calculators are a poor use of a run' while the explore prompt and recent explore runs keep shipping engineering calculators (earthwork, pipe sizing, PV strings); no line says where an exact multi-span solver falls. I judged it depth (indeterminate analysis + exact pattern envelope a chatbot gets wrong) and said so in the PR.
run_workflow_locally.py has no --dry-run to list which workflows a diff would trigger before running them all; I guessed the flag and got a usage error.

A new venture page must have an inbound sibling link (siblings.mjs orphan budget 0) and static <th> in every <table> (check_table_headers.py); neither is on the new-venture checklist I read, so both surfaced only in CI.

deviations.why: 'Calculators are a poor use of a run' - built a new structural calculator anyway, because a continuous-beam solver with an exact live-load pattern envelope is indeterminate analysis that span tables, free tools and the flagship's simple-span checks lack.
deviations.did: Shipped it with an independent exact-arithmetic differential check and a brute-force envelope test.
deviations.result: Merged with 24 tests and a 1e-11 differential agreement.

notes: Explore idea: continuous-beam-calculator, a multi-span beam solver (pin/fixed/free supports, point loads, moments, partial/tapered loads, D and L cases) with the live load patterned span by span exactly by superposition, then each governing pattern re-solved for its exact in-span peak. Exact Euler-Bernoulli elements with closed-form interiors. Verification: 24 node tests (textbook coefficients incl. 49/512 and 0.10125 wL^2, three-moment equation with unequal I, equilibrium/continuity, envelope vs brute force over 16 patterns); check/differential.py, an independent Macaulay solution in exact fractions, agrees on 60 random beams to 6.5e-12 (moment), 8.8e-12 (deflection), 5.9e-12 (reactions); page driven in headless Chromium at 1200 and 390 px with no console errors. Next: hinges/springs, a size picker, wiring into wall-framing-takeoff's floor and deck beams.
